creature_companion.description: The baseline working hound of the realm — no regional distinction, no special lineage. Found in every settlement across every biome, used for tracking, herding, guarding, and companionship. Reliable, affordable, and emotionally steady; the most common starting companion for new rangers and travellers.
creature_companion.temperament: Good-natured, adaptable, eager. A general-purpose companion and helper across all settled regions of the realm.
